correctness.rationale: The construction is correct for every real dimension \(n\ge2\), every nonempty finite \(F\subset S_{\ell_2^n}\), and every \(\eta>0\). With \(W=F\cup\{x-y:x,y\in F,\ x\ne y\}\), a unit vector \(u\) can be chosen outside the finitely many lines generated by \(W\), so \(c=\max_{w\in W}|\langle u,w\rangle|/\|w\|_2<1\). Choosing \(\max\{c,(1+\eta)^{-1}\}<a<1\) and \(p(z)=\max\{\|z\|_2,|\langle u,z\rangle|/a\}\) gives \(\|z\|_2\le p(z)<(1+\eta)\|z\|_2\) and exact equality with the Euclidean norm on all vectors in \(W\). Hence all sampled unit norms and pairwise distances are preserved. The unit ball is the Euclidean ball cut by the strip \(|\langle u,z\rangle|\le a\), producing nontrivial exposed faces, so \(p\) is not strictly convex and cannot be linearly isometric to the Euclidean norm.
